chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0603: The Seventeen World Prison - Power-Ups & Lore
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is mistaken for a prison warden! He learns about the Ninefate Chaos Kingdom, claims 18 bottles of precious Chaos Nectar, and gets a lead on mastering his clone technique.
og_description: Ji Ning's luck turns into a cosmic information jackpot as he poses as a warden to learn the secrets of a chaos-world prison.
twitter_description: Ji Ning scores 18 bottles of Chaos Nectar and the secrets to his clone technique by letting a gossipy jailer talk for three days.

lore_anchors.definition: A unit of time in the broader Chaosverse, equivalent to the lifespan of a Chaosworld (10 trillion years in Desolate Era).
A precious fluid distilled from the essence of chaos, used as a catalyst for high-level cultivation and soul-splitting techniques.
A powerful civilization existing within the endless Chaos, ruler of the stele-prison.
A secret technique allowing the cultivator to split their soul and body into eighteen identical, independent copies.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a vast prison-dimension inside Ji Ning's new stele, holding powerful prisoners from the Ninefate Chaos Kingdom.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How much Chaos Nectar does Ji Ning get?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He claims a total of eighteen bottles that have accumulated over three Chaos Cycles without tribute.
It's the specific treasure needed to master the second layer of the Tao Wu Eighteen Fiendgod Method, which lets him create eighteen identical bodies.
